subject: Q3 Progress Report
body:
Dear Investor,

I'm pleased to share our Q3 progress report with you.

Key Metrics:
- User growth: +150% month-over-month
- Revenue: $50K (target: $45K)
- Customer satisfaction: 4.8/5.0

Major Milestones:
- Launched mobile app
- Secured partnership with TechCorp
- Expanded team to 12 members

We're on track to meet our year-end goals. I'll be available for a call next week to discuss any questions you may have.

Best regards,
You
